notes:
SYNC: CONTINUE WATCHING AND YOUR LIBRARY NOW STAY IN STEP BETWEEN DEVICES. Watching something on the TV and not seeing it on the desktop had a real cause: each device wrote its whole list over the other's, so whichever one saved last won and the other's progress was gone. Every device now merges its changes into what is already stored instead of replacing it, on every table, and both apps re-check for changes each time you come back to them rather than only at startup. Dismissing a title from Continue Watching now sticks across devices too.

ACCOUNT SECURITY. You can reset a forgotten password: enter your account email and type the 6-digit code that arrives. New accounts confirm their email the same way. You can also change your password while signed in (it asks for the current one first) and log out of every device at once.

TV PLAYER. Redesigned: the title and its year, runtime, quality, HDR and audio sit together top-left, the play button is a clean ring in the middle, the progress bar is thinner with the time at each end, and Subtitles, Audio, Speed and Playback info are pills along the bottom showing what is currently selected. Skip Intro / Skip Outro floats above the progress bar and says where the skip starts; Next Episode sits at the end of the control row and names the episode.

TV FOCUS. Nothing grows when you move onto it any more. Posters, stream cards and player controls keep their size and light up instead, so a selected item no longer overlaps the ones beside it or makes the row jump.

TV SEARCH IS NOW GLOBAL. One search box, no Movies/Series/Anime buttons to pick first. Results come back grouped into just Movies and Series, one row each with Show all at the end - an anime film is a film, an anime show is a series. The on-screen keyboard closes when you press OK, and your query, your results and the item you opened are all still there when you come back from a title.

PROFILES. The TV home's Recommended row is now built from each profile's own viewing history instead of being shared across everyone on the account.
